note: Hypotheses, not findings. Each must pass its task in the account phase on the same battery and task list as VP. Prediction ids refer to research/2026-10-20/teardown/synthesis/predictions-consolidated.json (lane_id).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compliance by default: suppression on every path, category-aware windows, consent/inquiry ledger, series-aware CLI routing and an A2P declaration export, all on without configuration.
incumbent_failure_evidence: 8/8 leave Indian compliance to the buyer by contract or docs (RS-21..RS-24, SAR-44, VAP-47, RET-42/43, EL-38, SYN-62, EXO-45)
Retell batch calls ignore the DNC flag; DNC off by default (RET-43)
Synthflow opt-out exists only as a post-call judge field, which failed silently for 2 h 50 m on 2026-08-07 (SYN-66)
Bolna and Exotel publish wrong hours (9-21 for all calls) and Exotel says voice needs no DLT (RS-16, RS-17)
0 of 5 APIs have consent or DLT objects (measure.2026-10-20.acct-synthesis-india-operator-layer)
hypotheses.task: T2 messy CSV (rings on N2 must be 0) + T3 window battery (promo at 09:30 and 21:30 IST, service at 09:30, cross-midnight) + T9b mid-call opt-out then a second campaign
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP: 0 rings on N2 and on the mid-call opt-out number; promo 09:30 refused and service 09:30 allowed; incumbents: median >=1 ring on N2 or opt-out
hypotheses.kill_bar: 2 or more incumbents give 0 rings on N2 and on the opt-out number by default and refuse promo at 09:30 (then this is parity)
hypotheses.caveat: Compliance is 1.3% of coded complaints (RS-45): a must-be floor that fails suddenly, not the reason buyers switch.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CSV hygiene and campaign robustness: India-default normalisation, cross-format and cross-script dedupe, per-row reasons, retries by outcome and recurring windows in one upload.
incumbent_failure_evidence: Vapi dashboard prepends '+' (10-digit Indian mobile becomes +98...), one empty number rejects the file, no dedupe (VAP-49)
Retell contact import makes 10-digit numbers +1 and does not merge formats (RAP-54)
Vapi, Retell and Synthflow have no per-contact retries; Synthflow cancels a campaign after 7 days (VAP-47, RET-05, SYN-05)
ElevenLabs batch has one start time and no window (EL-05); Exotel needs two consoles and rejects rather than normalises (EXO-15/16)
Complaints: "because their batch calling didn't work I couldn't use any of it" (Synthflow Trustpilot 2024-12-06, SYN-70); Bolna 2026-10-13 "Some scheduled calls were not placed (India region)"
hypotheses.task: T2 messy 50-row CSV + T3 three-day recurring 10:00-19:00 IST schedule
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP handles >=48/50 rows as the spec expects in <5 min with 0 manual edits; incumbent median <=40/50 or >15 min including header fixes
hypotheses.kill_bar: Incumbent median >=45/50 rows correct and <5 min

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lower reply gap on Indian PSTN because media and brain run in India and turn release is pause-aware.
incumbent_failure_evidence: Retell US-West only; Indian users get "user not join" (RET-25, RET-54)
Vapi orchestration us-west-2, no India termination (VAP-20, VAP-42); forum: dashboard 575-1000 ms vs 3-4 s live (VAP-52)
ElevenLabs standard SIP signalling in us-central1 (EL-20); demo p50 3.75 s (l4b)
Sarvam demo p50 3.1 s browser-side vs <500 ms claim (SAR-35)
Bolna code holds each reply about 1.4 s (500 ms endpointing + 900 ms incremental delay, account phase)
hypotheses.task: Battery B on every vendor: 4 personas x 2 calls, >=30 clean turns per vendor, stereo at our Plivo edge
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP clean-turn p50 at least 0.3 s below the best incumbent and p90 <=2.5 s, with cut-ins <=5%
hypotheses.kill_bar: VP p50 not lower than the best India-hosted incumbent (Bolna, Sarvam, SquadStack, Exotel) by 0.3 s, or VP cut-ins above the incumbent median
hypotheses.caveat: VP itself is unproven: cascade reply gaps 1.6-2.2 s (Flash-Lite) and 15-42% cut-ins in the lab (open.2026-10-19.turn-taking).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hinglish turn-taking that never discards a short reply ("haan", "nahi", "ruko", "bas") and listens during the opening line.
incumbent_failure_evidence: Bolna discards finals of <=N words spoken over the agent unless they exactly match an English stop phrase (BC-19); drops caller speech during the welcome (ACB-35)
Vapi ships 22 English acknowledgement and 20 English interruption phrases by default (XS-21)
ElevenLabs answered "haan"/"hmm" with "Are you still there?" on 4 of 16 short turns (l4b)
Sarvam demo cut into the 2.4 s elderly pause 2/2 and went silent under babble 2/2 (SAR-53)
hypotheses.task: Battery items short_hmm/short_haan/short_ok, the barge turns, pause_mid_1.6s and the 2.4 s elderly pause; plus 4 scripted short Hindi replies spoken over the agent
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP handles >=90% of short replies correctly and stops within 600 ms on barge turns; incumbent median <=70%
hypotheses.kill_bar: VP not better than the incumbent median on the same items (risk.2026-10-20.acct-synthesis-turn-taking-beat-unproven)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Language hold on Hinglish, Hindi and Tamil-English, including numbers and times, against the non-Indian platforms.
incumbent_failure_evidence: Retell: Marathi agent drifts back to English (t/2502, 330 views); Hindi digit "छह" missed (t/2713); Telugu and Bengali unsupported (t/1645)
Synthflow: Hindi is the only Indic language; Multilingual delivery English-biased (SYN-65)
Vapi replied in Gujarati to a Hinglish caller on 17 of 18 turns (l4b; configuration-dependent)
ElevenLabs accepts its English default voice on a Hindi agent (XS-24); its demo forced English, so the l4b English replies are not evidence (EL-54)
hypotheses.task: Battery B language-ID per agent turn (machine LID plus manual read) and the number/time content checks
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP >=95% correct-language turns and >=90% number/time checks; better than Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs and Synthflow
hypotheses.kill_bar: Not a claim against Sarvam or SquadStack (CMP-08): drop W5 if VP is below either of them

hypotheses.hypothesis: Failure explainability: a failed call is found in under a minute with a business-language reason, the carrier code kept, and a suggested action.
incumbent_failure_evidence: Vapi: 638 engineering end codes (VAP-13)
Synthflow: end-reason labels keyed on raw Python exceptions and internal URLs (SYN-71); "Bot fails to make calls with no explanation" (Trustpilot 2024-07-17)
SquadStack: outcome label only, 10-day search window (SQS-18)
Bolna: 9 of 18 incidents were upstream Indian telephony with no carrier failover (BOL-40)
Exotel admits mislabelled outcomes and 29 s dead calls (EXO-58)
Radar: MyOperator now sells a human "AI Agent Manager" to find and fix failures (RAD-15)
hypotheses.task: T5: five induced failures (invalid row, our number rejects busy, answer-and-hang-up at 3 s, broken tool URL, out-of-window schedule); time to find each and a 0-2 actionability score
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP <60 s per failure, 5/5 reasons correct, score 2 on >=4/5; incumbent median >2 min or score <=1
hypotheses.kill_bar: Incumbent median <2 min with a correct, actionable reason on >=4/5

hypotheses.hypothesis: Minutes from sign-up to the first ring on an Indian handset from an Indian CLI, self-serve.
incumbent_failure_evidence: Vapi needs a second vendor (Twilio) and shows a +1 CLI (VAP-42/43)
Retell needs Persona KYC of a named person and sells US/CA numbers only (RET-12, RET-45)
Synthflow is review-gated from USD 30k/yr (SYN-03/04/40); SquadStack sign-in is allowlisted (SQS-70)
Exotel KYC takes 1-3 business days before calls beyond verified users (EXO-44)
Complaints: Bolna "Booked Demo many times since last 1 month, but not callback" (Trustpilot 2026-01-23); Exotel no AI-voice demo after a week (Trustpilot 2026-04-23)
hypotheses.task: T0 timed from the sign-up form to the first ring on our Plivo number; record the CLI series seen in the Plivo inbound webhook
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP <=15 min to a ring from an Indian CLI on a BYO or pre-provisioned number; incumbent median >=45 min
hypotheses.kill_bar: Bolna or Sarvam reach a ring from an Indian CLI in <=20 min
hypotheses.caveat: VP cannot skip the tenant's own KYC and DLT/PE registration; the edge is the guided path and bring-your-own-carrier.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fair, transparent billing: per-second or short pulses, one fee line, cost per campaign and contact, balance and spend cap on the API.
incumbent_failure_evidence: Sarvam 60 s agent pulses: a 30 s call costs INR 7.40 per connected minute (SAR-38); Exotel PSTN 60 s pulses (EXO-35)
Retell scales billed duration above 4,000 prompt tokens and has burst on by default (RET-34); ElevenLabs bursting on by default at 2x (XS-27)
Bolna USD 0.02 platform fee ambiguity (BOL-35); spend cap by API key at 0 of 5 (XS-28)
Complaints: billing 107 of 459 coded Indian complaints (RAW-17); Bolna refund unanswered for months (Trustpilot 2026-02-25); ElevenLabs "charging me credits for the AI agent's mistakes" (2026-07-24)
hypotheses.task: T7 invoice audit: 10 calls each of 30, 45 and 90 s per vendor; compare debits and invoice lines with the rate card
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP invoice equals its rate card within 1% and has the lowest effective INR/min on 30-90 s calls among at least 5 of 7 incumbents
hypotheses.kill_bar: Buyer interviews do not rank billing fairness among their top 5 switching reasons

hypotheses.hypothesis: Human support inside Indian business hours.
incumbent_failure_evidence: Retell active support 9 AM-9 PM PST = 21:30-09:30 IST (RET-48)
Vapi: no response SLA below Core (VAP-56)
ElevenLabs support routes to an AI agent that cannot resolve billing (Trustpilot 2026-06-11)
Synthflow: SUPPORT is 19 of 21 low reviews (SYN-70); Bolna Trustpilot 4/4 one-star on support and refunds
Support is the top Indian complaint code (114 of 459, RAW-17)
hypotheses.task: T8: one real setup question filed at 11:00 IST on a weekday; time to first human reply
hypotheses.pass_bar: Incumbent median >24 h against a VP target <2 h
hypotheses.caveat: An operating promise, not product; it costs headcount and must be priced into the tiers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The stored config is what runs, and every dashboard action is on the API and MCP, so a chat agent can set up and run a campaign end to end.
incumbent_failure_evidence: At 4 of 4 writable vendors an API-created agent stores or runs defaults that differ from docs or dashboard; 3 of 4 silently drop unknown fields (XS-07, XS-08)
No vendor lets an API key do everything the dashboard can (XS-16); Retell import/export are dashboard-only (RET-P08 note)
Synthflow silently ignores a GPT model value on non-enterprise plans (SYN-09)
hypotheses.task: T1 build by API and by the vendor copilot, read back, call, compare; then the chat builder runs T2-T6 without opening the dashboard
hypotheses.pass_bar: VP: 0 silent drops and 0 default drift; all of T2-T6 done through chat
hypotheses.kill_bar: An incumbent copilot (Sarvam Genie already builds, deploys and runs campaigns, SAR-03) completes T2-T6 without the dashboard
